scope: Automatic owned-project matching/creation plus requested UI/memory/assertion fixes.

checks.type_check: strict Pyright on changed code/tests, zero errors/warnings
checks.providers: mocked for automated tests; separate capped live proposal probe

implemented: Owned directory CAS/idempotent creation and host delegation
Normalized collision checks and stable rename/alias identity
Semantic route proposal validation before any event/tool/task writes
Ambiguity/multi-project/provider-failure choices and explicit manual override
General Personal space without invented task, including empty-directory bootstrap
Frozen scope and explicit source snapshots across in-browser retries
New conversation retrieves current canonical task under reused project ID
Directory owner export/primary erasure and quarantine
Project-origin USER memory filtering before ranking/LIMIT
Personal-scope marker and strict asserted quote/role/question evidence guards
Stale UI frame suppression, response scope checks, literal project labels
Approved current goal hints for existing configured projects, with task privacy/expiry checks
Legacy display-name metadata overlay preserves configured IDs, bindings, existing host grants and canonical tasks
Explicit source-quoted new-project confirmation when conservative automatic creation guards reject a proposal
limitations: Model proposals/confidence are semantic heuristics; no live accuracy benchmark was run.
Unsent drafts are local to the browser until routing/recording, not crash-durable.
No automatic project merge, historical transcript move or bulk context/task rollback.
Legacy ambiguous project-origin personal preferences may need explicit reassertion; no records are deleted.
Directory 64 entries, eight aliases; existing configured grants and owner trust partition retained.
No production-readiness or comparative usefulness claim.
